2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch series adds a check to the checkpatch.pl script that suggests converting raw __attribute__((nonnull)) attribute usage to the preferred __nonnull_args() macro, consistent with existing attribute conversion suggestions.

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch series adds a check to the checkpatch.pl script suggesting the use of the __nonnull_args() macro over the raw __attribute__((nonnull)) spelling for marking pointer arguments as non-NULL, consistent with existing attribute conversion suggestions.
